list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT A_publisher 
FROM md_subscriptions 
WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', 1) IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND SUBSTRING(symbol, LOCATE('@', symbol) + 1) IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
ORDER BY A_publisher

FROM md_subscriptions 
WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', 1) IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND SUBSTRING(symbol, LOCATE('@', symbol) + 1) IN (${exchange:sqlstring})

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT A_fh 
FROM md_subscriptions 
WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', 1) IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND SUBSTRING(symbol, LOCATE('@', symbol) + 1) IN (${exchange:sqlstring}) AND A_publisher IN (${apub:sqlstring}) 
ORDER BY A_fh
list.label: Source FH
list.name: afh
list.query:

ORDER BY A_fh

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT B_repeater
FROM md_subscriptions 
WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', 1) IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', -1) IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND A_publisher IN (${apub:sqlstring})
  AND A_fh IN (${afh:sqlstring})
  AND B_repeater != ''
ORDER BY B_repeater

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(machine) AS machine
FROM md_subscriptions 
WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', 1) IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(symbol, '@', -1) IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (A_publisher IN (${apub:sqlstring}) OR A_fh IN (${afh:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY UPPER(machine)
